newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Palmer wants to remove ANI directors.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Palmer wants to remove ANI directors.

text.p: Ross Palmer, voted off the board of Australian National Industries Ltd (ANI) last month, said on Friday he had sought an extraordinary general meeting of the engineering company to remove two directors, Peter Joseph and Howard Stack.

Palmer, the largest individual shareholder in Sydney-based ANI with a five percent stake, said his private company would canvass other major shareholders to decide on suitable replacements for Joseph and Stack.
Joseph was instrumental in having Palmer dismissed from the board in a vote at last month's annual meeting.
